verdict.rationale: Kong documents extensive public APIs (Admin API, RESTful config, OpenAPI spec directory) and provides a CLI (decK) verified hands-on to install and run, plus an Admin API accessible for automation and AI-agent-driven workflows; the AI Gateway/MCP layer also exposes governance over API traffic for agentic systems. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API completeness/stability beyond Kong's own docs and probes.
